A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TwiUSD/MRFG research work, with all 14 pages and Appendices A–F available. Pages 2–14 have identical extracted text and rendered content; page 1 differs only in authorship information and the version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original MRFG experiments on TwiUSD, including in-target and cross-target results in Tables 3–4, ablations, filtering comparisons, and appendix hashtag-labeling and error analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original MRFG experiments in Tables 3–4 and Figure 3, together with the original analyses in Appendices C and F.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same LLM-FU relevance filtering, S-TFI feature ranking, RGCN/MLP feature routing, output fusion, and cross-entropy objective.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TwiUSD data, comprising 16,211 users and 47,757 tweets, with Biden and Trump targets and identical in-target and cross-target coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 3–4. The cosine-based filtering comparison in Section 6.4 and UUSDT/DoubleH labeling comparison in Appendix C are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the 70/15/15 data split, class-specific F1, Favg and accuracy metrics, in-target and cross-target procedures, and feature-selection ratio r = 0.3 for the main results. No experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: The component ablations, LLM-versus-cosine filtering comparison, feature-ratio sensitivity analysis, hashtag-labeling analysis, and error cases are identical in Sections 6.3–6.6 and Appendices C and F.

E5.justification: Both report averaging over three runs with different random seeds, paired two-tailed t-tests with p < 0.05, and the same annotation-agreement statistics. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are retained, including appendix results. For example, Table 3 reports identical MRFG Favg scores of 84.19 for Biden and 81.27 for Trump in both versions.

T1.justification: The task definition and Equations (1)–(4), including mutual-information feature scoring and RGCN propagation, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about TwiUSD's novelty and scale, MRFG's contributions, and in-target and cross-target performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of filtering and feature routing, cross-target transfer limitations, sparse-tweet and conflicting-followee failures, and limitations concerning modalities and external knowledge are unchanged.

D1.justification: Data-construction details, model descriptions, GPT-4o filtering prompts, and baseline implementation information are identical. Both retain the promise to release data and code upon acceptance; no technical or resource-access information changes.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, in-text citations, bibliography, and positioning relative to previous datasets and methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: The title page corrects 'Fuaing Niu' to 'Fuqiang Niu' and adds Hu Huang, an affiliation, and an email address. Scientific prose, terminology, headings, and document organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author and affiliation block slightly changes the title-page layout, and the margin version/date stamp is updated. Figures, tables, captions, and the layout of pages 2–14 are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 updates authorship information and slightly adjusts the title-page layout. The scientific narrative, evidence, analyses, limitations, and reproducibility information are unchanged, so these edits do not materially alter overall paper quality.
